limitations: Synthetic simulator metrics do not establish real-world accuracy or causal effects.
The fixed test set contains 45 shipments and bootstrap intervals remain coarse.
The weather plus reduced recovery stress family is not represented by existing Phase 1 mechanisms.
The existing Phase 2 prediction service is backward compatible but does not consume Phase 3 calibration artifacts; Phase 3 bundles are separate.
The derived probability is a small-sample empirical calibration approximation, not a classifier or conformal probability distribution.

direct_classifier.reason: Small 45-shipment calibration/test sets and class imbalance do not justify an uncalibrated classifier.

formula.normalization_rationale: Remaining-time residual magnitude can scale with journey duration; normalization expresses calibration errors relative to the propagation duration and rescales those relative errors to the new prediction. This assumes approximate proportional error scaling and is not guaranteed by the data-generating process.
formula.probability: mean(predicted_remaining_new + z_i * s_new > scheduled_delivery_at + threshold_hours - checkpoint_at)
